name: shopright-monorepo
description: Hyperlocal marketplace app (Customer, Merchant, Delivery Partner, Admin) with unified backend

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "API,CUSTOMER,MERCHANT,DELIVERY,ADMIN" -c "green,cyan,yellow,blue,magenta" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:customer" "npm run dev:merchant" "npm run dev:delivery" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "API,CUSTOMER,MERCHANT,DELIVERY,ADMIN" -c "green,cyan,yellow,blue,magenta" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:customer" "npm run dev:merchant" "npm run dev:delivery" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.dev:frontends: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "CUSTOMER,MERCHANT,DELIVERY,ADMIN" -c "cyan,yellow,blue,magenta" "npm run dev:customer" "npm run dev:merchant" "npm run dev:delivery" "npm run dev:admin"

author: ShopRight Team
